proposals.evidence: DEDR1973 explicitly gives Gondi kel hair/feather, plural -k. Survey kelk/kelku/kellku and kello retain that same-language hair family with source number/final-vowel and consonant-length notation. Ordinary plural morphology is not a separate derivation. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3748 gives Kannada nettar(u)/nettara/nettra, Tulu netterů and Gondi nettur/netur/nattur blood. Selected netter-/nettr-/naṭṭr-type survey responses preserve that stem with vowel variation or syncope; opaque Gondi naktur/naktar responses are excluded pending stronger consonant evidence. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
